svg.text: Same event. 3 fragile regexes vs 9 indexed fields. Distributed systems demand the right side.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: Unstructured falls apart at log volume - format drift breaks parsers, queries scale O(bytes), aggregations need ETL.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: Structured turns logs into a queryable database: indexed fields, group-by aggregations, joinable on trace_id.
